description: Curiosity ChemCam (LIBS MOC) and APXS oxide results for the study sols, one record per instrument, target and sol (mean of its observation points), placed at the rover's PLACES position for that site and drive.
placement_note: The dot is where Curiosity stood, not the target: ChemCam targets are 2 to 7 m away, APXS targets beside the arm.

sources.release: MSL PDS Release 42 (ChemCam and APXS through sol 4843)
sources.credit: ChemCam: NASA/JPL-Caltech/LANL/CNES; APXS: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Guelph; via the PDS Geosciences Node
